name: recipe-book-mcp
description: MCP server for the Recipe Book: search, read, add, edit, and share recipes.

auth.description: OAuth 2.1 via Supabase Auth. The server publishes protected-resource metadata, so standard MCP clients discover the authorization server, register themselves (dynamic client registration), and run the authorization-code + PKCE flow; the user approves on the recipe site's consent page and the client renews with refresh tokens. A plain Supabase session JWT also still works as Authorization: Bearer <jwt>.
